title: The Pragmatic Programmer
author: Andy Hunt & Dave Thomas
description: One of the most significant books on software development. From responsibility and career development to architectural techniques, this classic helps you become a better programmer.

reviews.comment: This book changed how I think about writing code and managing my career.
Timeless advice, although some examples are a bit dated.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
description: Even bad code can run. But if code isn't clean, it can bring a development organization to its knees. This book presents a paradigm for writing code that is clean, readable, and maintainable.

reviews.comment: A must-read for any junior developer joining a team.

title: Refactoring
author: Martin Fowler
description: Refactoring is a controlled technique for improving the design of an existing body of code, without altering its external behavior. This book provides a detailed catalog of refactorings.

reviews.comment: Fowler's second edition is excellent. Examples in JS are easy to follow.
